lexicon.name: Species: Angel & Celestial

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Succubus & Incubus

A specialized lineage of infernal demons attuned to emotional resonance, psychic attraction, and the absorption of vital essences through intimate contact and social connection.

Physiology & Aura:
Succubi and Incubi possess breathtaking, alluring aesthetics, slender bat-like or leathery wings, curving horns, and heart- or spade-tipped prehensile tails. They emit potent, intoxicating pheromones capable of relaxing inhibitions and heightening romantic or carnal tension in surrounding beings.

Feeding & Daily Life:
While capable of subsisting on normal food and drink, they maintain peak physical and magical vitality by absorbing passionate emotional energy, pleasure, and vital essence (symbiotic feeding). In modern society, they excel as nightclub proprietors, entertainers, influencers, psychologists, and charismatic negotiators.
lexicon.name: Species: Succubus & Incubus

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Demon & Infernal

Demons are sapient beings native to the Infernal planes and Abyssal rifts, fully integrated into the modern supernatural underworld, corporate hierarchies, and magical academia.

Physiology & Traits:
Demons exhibit exotic skin complexions (crimson, obsidian, deep violet, or olive), prominent cranial horns of varied curvature, prehensile muscular tails often ending in spade or barbed tips, and vertical pupiled irises. Their internal body temperature runs notably higher than humans, granting natural heat resistance.

Social Standing:
Demons possess raw physical might, indomitable presence, and razor-sharp bargaining instincts. In urban centers like Los Angeles and Solarton, they operate private detective agencies (e.g., Damien Bishop), underground clubs, and high-stakes criminal syndicates.
lexicon.name: Species: Demon & Infernal

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Fairy & Fae

The Fae encompass enchanting, magical beings connected to the Otherworld and natural glamours, ranging from palm-sized winged pixies to human-proportioned demi-fae.

Physiology & Magic:
Fae possess delicate, shimmering gossamer wings capable of agile flight, radiant skin, and natural glamours that alter sensory perception. They possess an innate, playful charisma and high kinetic agility, balanced by delicate physical endurance.

Social Dynamics:
Known for sharp wit, bureaucratic cunning (such as fae executive assistants and fixers), and artistic excellence. They abide by strict ancient rules of hospitality, bargains, and spoken promises, viewing casual verbal agreements with contractual gravity.
lexicon.name: Species: Fairy & Fae

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Elf & Sidhe

Elves are long-lived, highly refined humanoids with slender, graceful frames, pointed ears, and an innate affinity for intricate spellcraft, botanical sciences, and formal diplomacy.

Physiology & Longevity:
Living for multiple centuries without cellular senescence, elves maintain flawless skin, graceful carriage, heightened sensory perception, and keen visual acuity. Their elongated, elegant ears are sensitive to ambient acoustic vibrations and micro-expressions.

Cultural & Professional Spheres:
Elves excel as academic researchers, arcane botanical specialists, corporate legal strategists, and high-tier rift arcanists. They balance historical pride with contemporary modern lifestyles, often occupying prominent faculty chairs at universities like SUCC and CUMS.
lexicon.name: Species: Elf & Sidhe

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Minotaur & Centaur

The large ungulate species encompass towering, heavy-frame demihumans and chimeras known for colossal physical strength, enduring constitution, and imposing stature in both sports and security sectors.

Physiology & Adaptations:
- Minotaurs: Massive bipedal humanoids standing between 6'6" and 7'6", featuring broad taurine horns, hooved or reinforced digitigrade feet, heavy bone density, and unmatched physical resilience.
- Centaurs: Equine lower body combined with a powerful human torso, requiring specialized architectural adaptations in modern buildings (wide ramps, high-clearance doorways, modified transit seating).

Role in Society:
Commonly found in high-contact athletics (such as the Bulls football team), frontline Guild defense squads, industrial manufacturing, and private bodyguard details due to their natural shock-absorption and frontline dominance.
lexicon.name: Species: Minotaur & Centaur

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Demihuman (Kemonomimi)

Demihumans (part-animal humanoids, commonly referred to as demi-humans or kemonomimi) form one of the largest demographic populations in modern fantasy California and the SUCC campus.

Physiology & Single-Ear Rule:
Demihumans possess a predominantly human body with distinct bestial physical traits inherited from their animal lineage (ears, tails, horns, reptilian scales, plumage, tongues, fangs, or slit pupils). 
CRITICAL ANATOMY: Demihumans possess only a single pair of ears: their animal ears atop the head. They do not have a second pair of human ears on the sides of the skull. Demihumans do not have full animal fur coats or paws on their bodies; their limbs and torso are smooth human skin.

Behavior & Instincts:
Demihumans express emotional cues vividly through their bestial anatomy: flattening ears when threatened or distressed, wagging or whipping tails, pupils expanding during arousal or predatory focus, and scent-marking trusted companions. Their instincts naturally flavor their personality without overriding sapient autonomy.
lexicon.name: Species: Demihuman (Kemonomimi)

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Shifter & Anthro

Shifters encompass non-lupine therianthropes and beast-shifters capable of alternating between humanoid, hybrid-anthro, and full beast forms. This includes feline shifters (cougars, leopards), ursine shifters (bears), vulpine shifters, and raptors.

Physiology & Anatomy:
Unlike demihumans who maintain a permanent human body with animal appendages, Shifters possess an active morphogenic reservoir allowing structural body transformation. In hybrid or shifted states, they manifest enhanced skeletal density, predatory instincts, natural armaments (horns, antlers, razor claws), and animal vocalizations.

Social Standing:
Often integrated into urban syndicates, private military contractors, and wilderness enclaves. They balance primal predatory impulses with modern civilization, frequently working as high-impact enforcers, athletes, or rift scouts.
lexicon.name: Species: Shifter & Anthro

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Werewolf & Lycanthrope

Werewolves are predatory shapeshifters organized into territorial packs governed by the Lupine Social Environment (LSE hierarchy: Alphas, Betas, Deltas, Omegas). In the Svartulfr setting, prominent wolf dynasties such as the Douglas and Bloodmoon bloodlines hold sovereign sway over Blackwood City.

Physiology & Anatomy:
Werewolves possess dense muscle fiber, heightened olfactory and auditory senses capable of reading emotional shifts and pheromones, rapid cellular regeneration, and formidable bite force. They can execute a Partial Shift (displaying pointed lupine ears at the top of the skull, elongated fangs, retractable claws, and enhanced musculature) or a Full Shift into a massive quadrupedal dire wolf. Demi-human anatomy rules apply: they possess only a single pair of ears (lupine, no second pair of human ears).

Vulnerabilities & Biology:
Severe biological allergy and tissue rejection to refined silver, which arrests cellular regeneration and burns upon contact. Subject to instinctual rut and heat cycles governed by lunar and pack resonance.
lexicon.name: Species: Werewolf & Lycanthrope

lexicon.content:
Species Overview: Human

Humans constitute the baseline non-magical demographic of modern Earth, coexisting alongside supernatural beings, demihumans, and mythological races in metropolitan centers like Blackwood City, Solarton, and Los Angeles. 

Physiology & Anatomy:
Standard terrestrial biology without inherent physical transformations, acute beast senses, or native spellcasting reservoirs. While physically more fragile than werewolves, demons, or apex demihumans, humans possess immense adaptability, technological ingenuity, and societal governance roles.

Magic & Tech Integration:
Lacking internal mana cores, humans rely heavily on external magitech implements, enchanted ammunition, runic tech, or contracts with supernatural entities to operate within planar rifts and Dungeon incursions. In urban areas, humans drive commercial enterprise, civic administration, and legal infrastructure alongside supernatural Great Houses.
lexicon.name: Species: Human

Focus on the predatory focus, the physical changes (swelling knots, intense heat, heightened strength), and the uncontrollable drive to claim and breed. Describe the forceful, relentless thrusting, the painful but deeply satisfying expansion of the knot locking the partners together, and the raw, guttural growls of purely animalistic mating.

Detail the friction of scales against soft human skin, the extreme size differential, and the mechanics of alien anatomy such as internal slits, ridged/barbed phalluses, or dual members (hemipenes). lexicon.content: Necromancy is the forbidden art of tethering stray souls back into physical vessels or manipulating ambient spiritual energy. Visually, it is accompanied by sickly green or purple soul-fire, a palpable drop in temperature, and the unsettling murmurs of restless spirits. The toll is spiritual and mental; necromancers risk possession, severe spiritual degradation, and a constant, maddening connection to the echoes of the dead. In a Dungeon, necromancers can reanimate fallen creatures to serve as fodder, disable spiritual traps, or interrogate the lingering memories of previous adventurers. In Urban areas, necromancy is fiercely hunted by DDM Inc. and the authorities, though rogue practitioners use it to extract secrets from the recently deceased or build expendable undead labor forces in the city's underbelly.
lexicon.name: Magic: Necromancy

lexicon.content: Explicitly detail the physical stretching and intense fullness of eggs being deposited into an orifice or the abdomen. Describe the slimy texture, the rhythmic pulsing of the ovipositor, and the visible bulging of the partner's stomach. Focus on the psychological mix of primal terror, extreme violation, and deeply forced biological arousal as the character becomes an incubator.
lexicon.name: Kink: Oviposition (Eggs)

lexicon.content: Death powers channel the fundamental forces of entropy and decay, breaking down organic and inorganic matter. Visually, it manifests as a graying, ash-like aura, the immediate wilting of nearby plant life, and an unnatural, chilling stillness in the air. The toll on the caster is severe, often accelerating their own cellular aging, causing a pale complexion, and slowly degrading their internal organs with repeated use. In a Dungeon, these powers are devastatingly effective for decaying structural supports to create traps, or instantly rotting the armor and flesh of formidable beasts. In an Urban environment, death magic is highly taboo and heavily regulated, used clandestinely for untraceable assassinations or by specialized cleanup crews to disintegrate evidence.
lexicon.name: Magic: Death powers

lexicon.content: Vividly describe the ethereal, glowing nature of bodily fluids (saliva, cum, slick) in dark environments. Focus on the visual contrast of glowing neon colors against skin, the unique temperature or texture of the fluids (e.g., abnormally hot or viscous), and the surreal, monstrous aesthetic it brings to sexual acts. Detail the lingering luminescent marks left on the partner's body.
lexicon.name: Kink: Bioluminescent Fluids

lexicon.content: Healing power accelerates the body's natural regenerative processes through arcane means. Visually, it is subtle, often presenting as a warm, golden or pale-green glow around the caster's hands and the target's wounds, accompanied by the rapid knitting of flesh and bone. The physical toll is shared; the caster often absorbs a fraction of the target's pain and expends their own caloric energy to fuel the rapid cell division, leading to extreme hunger and exhaustion. In a Dungeon, healers are the backbone of any party, keeping contractors alive through grievous injuries and neutralizing toxins. In an Urban setting, underground biomancers are highly sought after by criminal syndicates and unlicensed mercenaries who cannot risk a visit to a conventional hospital.
lexicon.name: Magic: Healing power

lexicon.content:
Nella cultura dei licantropi norreni della Founding Bloodline e dell'antico lignaggio Svartulfr, ogni individuo riceve alla nascita un nome civile. All'eta di tredici anni, durante il sacro rito della Presentazione in cui si manifesta per la prima volta la bestia interiore, il licantropo scopre e dichiara il nome del proprio lupo spirituale. Per legge ancestrale del branco, questo nome viene assunto come secondo nome ufficiale e formale dell'individuo, sancendo la transizione verso l'eta adulta e l'accettazione del proprio spirito ferino.

I Pilastri Mitologici e Dinastici della Tradizione:
1. Il Mito Primordiale di Hvit e la Prima Compagna di Wulfnic: La prima Hvit delle origini nacque dall'unione mistica tra Mani (la divinita maschile della Luna) e Hati Hrodvitnisson (che nella cosmologia di Svartulfr e la sacra lupa primordiale). Questa prima lupa bianca divenne la prima compagna eterna di Wulfnic Bloodmoon, il capostipite creato da Fenris. Alla sua morte, la sua essenza lunare e il suo spirito protettivo si legano indissolubilmente al sangue Bloodmoon, reincarnandosi in ogni generazione attraverso le White Moon.
2. Il Vincolo delle White Moon: Tutte le reincarnazioni della lupa primordiale portano immancabilmente per legge sacra il nome del lupo originale: Hvit (la Bianca). Per questo motivo sia Nixara sia sua figlia Alyssa portano Hvit come secondo nome formale (Nixara Hvit Bloodmoon e Alyssa Hvit Douglas Bloodmoon), e per questo l'antico patriarca Wulfnic vede in Alyssa il riflesso vivente e benedetto della sua compagna perduta.
3. La Stirpe Solare di Svartr e Skoll: In simmetria perfetta e opposta ad Hvit, la controparte maschile dell'eclissi solare discende dall'unione tra Sol (la divinita femminile del Sole) e il lupo Skoll. Se Hvit incarna la pura luce lunare (Bianco), la progenie di Skoll assume il nome di Svartr (il Lupo Nero / l'Ombra Solare). Da questo archetipo millenario, Jasper Douglas assume alla sua Presentazione il nome di lupo Svartr (Jasper Svartr Douglas Bloodmoon), creando con la gemella Alyssa Hvit la perfetta polarita cosmica del branco.
4. I Secondi Nomi Nobiliari Inglesi vs Wolf Names Norreni: Nella Casa Douglas, a causa della tradizione nobiliare mercantile britannica stabilita dal patriarca Magnus dopo il 1666, ai primogeniti vengono spesso assegnati secondi nomi civili dell'aristocrazia inglese (come Cornelius per Erik e Dominic per Logan). Questi coesistono con i loro veri Wolf Names assunti alla Presentazione (Erik Ulfr e Logan Jarn).
5. I Licantropi Militari (Nargathon e Project Blackwolf): I lupi cresciuti ed addestrati all'interno delle gerarchie militari e dei battaglioni d'assalto (come Kaladin Nargathon e Marcus Thornfield) sostituiscono il nome lupino tradizionale con codici tattici e call-sign operativi. Kaladin fu il primo soggetto in assoluto a venire sottoposto alle sperimentazioni genetiche dell'esercito, assumendo il call-sign "Blackwolf" che diede il nome all'intero programma segreto Project Blackwolf (mentre Marcus porta il call-sign operativo "Iron").
6. Distinzione Sacra tra Licantropi e Demi-Umani (Kemonomimi): La Presentazione, i Wolf Names e le Birth-Runes appartengono esclusivamente ai veri Licantropi dotati di facolta mutaforma (Shift). I Demi-Umani Lupo (come Finnegan Novak) sono Kemonomimi privi della capacita biologica di mutare in forma ibrida o quadrupede; nella societa conservatrice dei branchi antichi, questa differenza biologica li rendeva storicamente oggetto di disprezzo ed esclusione, etichettati brutalmente come "mezzi-lupi".
7. I Nove Firstblood: I nove guerrieri originali creati direttamente da Fenris (tra cui Wulfnic Bloodmoon) non possiedono un secondo nome separato. Essendo entita ancestrali unificate in cui uomo e lupo non sono mai stati divisi, il loro nome da lupo coincide identicamente con il loro nome vichingo di nascita.
8. I Giovani Pre-Presentazione: I cuccioli e i giovani licantropi che non hanno ancora compiuto tredici anni o non hanno ancora superato la cerimonia della Presentazione (come Edric Douglas) non possiedono un nome da lupo e usano unicamente il nome di battesimo civile.

Esattamente il quinto giorno dopo la nascita del neonato, il patriarca o l'anziano del branco celebra l'incisione della runa dell'antico Futhark che ne dichiara l'essenza spirituale, il temperamento e il vincolo col destino.

- L'Inchiostro del Vincolo: L'inchiostro viene preparato miscelando carbone di legna sacra purificata con polvere finissima di ferro freddo (cold iron).
